notes: CAC beneficial ownership register ('Persons With Significant Control'). Public via browser; React SPA with API at borapp.cac.gov.ng/api (/bor-search/get_psc POST, get_psc_details). SECURITY NOTE: a token-less POST to /auth/access-token returned an individual user's PII (broken access control) — NOT used/stored, not bypassed; flagged as a data-protection concern. Beneficial owners are personal data (NDPA 2023) — redact.
